Subject: POC kickoff — alignment on stakeholders, agenda, and lab slots

Hi Laura —

Great to be working with the NimbleBank team. We'd like to lock a 90-minute POC kickoff that includes:
- intro + roles (10m)
- architecture & data/ingest constraints (15m)
- prompt review and routing patterns (20m)
- hands-on lab: runbook walkthrough + prompt tests (30m)
- load-test plan and next steps (15m)

Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue May 5: 10:00–11:30 AM PT
- Wed May 6: 1:00–2:30 PM PT
- Thu May 7: 8:30–10:00 AM PT

Can you confirm who will represent product (goals & success criteria), engineering (routing/load), and security/compliance? Also flag any must-have success criteria for the POC so we can bake them into the runbook and load tests.

I've attached a draft agenda and a short runbook stub for internal review. If these times don't work, happy to propose alternatives — we have flexibility that week.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
[jasmine_liu@redwood.ai]
[Attachment: POC-Agenda-v0.3.pdf (PDF)]

From: laura@nimblebank.com
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@nimblebank.com
Date: Sun, 03 May 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — alignment on stakeholders, agenda, and lab slots

Thanks, Jasmine —

We'd like to take Wed May 6 1:00–2:30 PM PT. I'll be there (Laura Chen, Head of Product). Joining from our side:
- Tom Gray <tom.gray@nimblebank.com> — Engineering lead (routing & infra)
- Priya Shah <priya.shah@nimblebank.com> — Security/compliance (will listen & follow up with audit questions)
- Sara Ortiz <sara.ortiz@nimblebank.com> — Data ops (ingest pipeline)

High-level success criteria for the POC:
1) Demonstrate sub-200ms median generation latency for 2 concurrent user flows with a 1k token context.
2) Show routing fallback between a cheaper quantized model and a higher-quality variant without >5% error-rate regression on a reference prompt set.
3) Validate end-to-end prompt handling with our redaction rules in place (no customer PII persisted).

Procurement is cc'd — they will need estimate of committed hours for dedicated lab time and any NDAs prior to running sensitive examples.

Keen to see your runbook.

—Laura
Laura Chen
Head of Product, NimbleBank
[Attachment: initial_requirements.docx (referenced)]
